cept_reference_comparison.note: Original CEPT methods (DOI 10.1038/s41592-021-01126-2) explicitly use Sigma P8483 at 1:1000. It is not a substitution relative to that paper. The later Tocris kit has a different supplied form; equivalence after reconstitution is unverified, and different physical form alone does not establish chemical non-equivalence.

materials.name: 2-fluorophenyl gluconamide (2FA)
materials.availability: Not verified as a commercial catalog reagent in the primary-source search.

identity.identity_status: Exact molecule name and structure are disclosed in the article/supplement; no catalog identifier or CAS was verified.

materials.custom_synthesis_note: The source literature describes a laboratory-designed, synthesized N-aryl-D-gluconamide series and the supplement gives synthesis/characterization for N-(2-fluorophenyl)-D-gluconamide. Plan for custom or source-lab synthesis plus identity/purity confirmation unless a supplier can provide a structure-matched lot and analytical documentation.
uncertainties: 2-fluoroaniline is only a starting material and must not be treated as 2FA.
No verified commercial catalog source, CAS, package, or price was found for the exact 2FA molecule.
A supplier quote would need to specify N-(2-fluorophenyl)-D-gluconamide, D-gluconamide stereochemistry, analytical identity, purity, and lot documentation.

global_notes: Original CEPT paper methods specify Chroman 1 MedChem Express HY-15392, Emricasan Selleckchem S7775, Sigma P8483, and Tocris trans-ISRIB 5284. Tocris Chroman 1 and Emricasan listings above are candidate alternate vendors, not the original paper's vendors; verify chemical form and lot identity. Root checked the original methods in local biology-PMC8314867.xml.
Catalog availability and displayed price are time- and region-specific; no purchase or vendor contact was performed.
